# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_VOLUME_IMBALANCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the first 30-minute opening range shows significant downside volume bias (down-bar volume exceeding up-bar volume by ≥40% and price below midpoint at 10:00), the subsequent hour often continues the bias, offering a short edge. This edge exists because institutional order flow imbalance during the opening range frequently persists as smart money continues to distribute shares.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Calculate volume of up bars (close>open) and down bars (close<open) within 09:30-10:00 ET. If down-bar volume ≥ 1.4 × up-bar volume AND price at 10:00 is below the midpoint of the opening range ( (OH+OL)/2 ), enter short at the next bar's open (10:05 bar open).  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the high of the opening range (chart-stop). Target at 1R (distance from entry to stop). After target hit, trail runner with a 10% premium-stop of ATR(14) (using 5m ATR). Exit on trail stop hit or 15:50 ET time stop.
